literal_meaning: হাভা পাখির মতো (a bird known for its voracious appetite)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হাভাতের মতো অর্থের লোভে কোনো কাজই করতে চায় না।
এই ব্যবসায়ী হাভাতে, সবকিছু নিজের করে নেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is as greedy as a hawk when it comes to money and won't share anything.
That businessman is extremely greedy, swallowing up every opportunity for himself.
note: Refers to a mythical or folkloric bird symbolizing insatiable greed in Bengali folklore.
